CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 38

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

3. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

5. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 12.5
   D. 25

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 36

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 88
   C. 38
   D. 19

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 30

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 15
   D. 44

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 90
   C. 21
   D. 30

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 17
   C. 66
   D. 34

22. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 6
   C. 17
   D. 11

23. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

24. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
